scope: Explicit trusted maintenance only; no HTTP, scheduler, expired guest authentication or application-resource transfer.

operations.atomicity: Per subject, not per batch; repeated selection may select additional still-active expired guests.
Original random command from existing request-key owner; kernel/lifecycle/all guest sessions and families/required audit/outbox commit together.
Reconcile exact original command under current service query policy, without new admission, mutation replay or credential delivery.

CleanupRequest.RunID: Canonical random identity.CommandID, preserved across retries.
CleanupRequest.After: Optional exact exclusive expiry/user seek cursor; grants no eligibility or authority.

CleanupSubjectRequest.UserID: Canonical exact anonymous subject; never a permanent target.
CleanupSubjectRequest.RunID: Same original random run correlation for exact per-subject retry.

requests.RecoveryQuery: Exact original returned command/tenant/user/record/service actor/kind/operation scope; no anonymous-flow or link mode. Configured actor is never request-selectable.

CleanupItem.Outcome: Original identity.CommitOutcome; unknown/in-progress is not rollback.
CleanupItem.Recovery: Save every nonempty original query; empty after uncertain key admission requires same subject/run retry.
CleanupItem.Error: Batch-only redacted per-item error, without provider/SQL diagnostics.

CleanupResult.Next: Last attempted seek position; reconcile unknown work before advancing.
CleanupResult.LagKnown: True only after successful tenant-wide backlog observation.
CleanupResult.RemainingLag: Oldest active expiry lag including held rows, saturating at 8760 hours; meaningful only with LagKnown.

invariants: Configured service policy authorizes selection and each subject; current query policy authorizes recovery.
Selection uses authoritative database time and the existing tenant/expiry/user active partial index.
Retention callbacks run outside SQL; original generations and earliest positive-evidence deadline are checked in the final protected transaction.
Stored delete/anonymize/retain remain distinct. Legal holds and validated retention deferrals stay pending; unavailable policy stops the batch.
Missing lifecycle or partial/contradictory retained evidence never proves success or rollback.
Completed permanent upgrades are excluded; intervening cleanup prevents previously admitted upgrade from consuming protected proof or producing permanent credentials.
Reference selection enables no HTTP and retains tenant/initialization/shutdown guards.

errors.denied_or_deferred: identity.ForbiddenError; batch may continue only after validated negative decision.
errors.unknown: identity.UnknownCommitError with original command metadata; reconcile rather than invent success or rollback.
errors.unavailable: identity.UnavailableError or context cancellation/deadline; stop and retain attempted results.
